gui.mlog.link.far: Target is out of link range
gui.mlog.link.hint: Left-click a block to link, right-click or ESC to exit
instruction.mlog.end.tip: Jump to the top of the instruction stack.
instruction.mlog.format.tip:
Replace next placeholder in text buffer with a value.
Does not do anything if placeholder pattern is invalid.
Placeholder pattern: "{[accent]number 0-9[]}"
Example:
[accent]print "test {0}"
format "example"
instruction.mlog.getlink.tip: Get a processor link by index. Starts at 0.
instruction.mlog.packcolor.tip: Pack [0, 1] RGBA components into a single number for drawing or rule-setting.
instruction.mlog.print.tip:
Add text to the print buffer.
Does not display anything until [accent]Print Flush[] is used.
instruction.mlog.printchar.tip:
Add a UTF-16 character to the print buffer.
Does not display anything until [accent]Print Flush[] is used.
instruction.mlog.printflush.tip: Flush queued [accent]Print[] operations to a sign.
instruction.mlog.read.tip:
Read a number from a linked memory cell.
Can also read from variables in other processors.
instruction.mlog.select.tip: Conditionally set a variable to one of two values.
instruction.mlog.sensor.tip: Get data from a building or unit.
instruction.mlog.setrate.tip:
Set processor execution speed in instructions/tick.
Cannot surpass maximum execution speed.
instruction.mlog.unpackcolor.tip: Unpack RGBA components from a color that was packed using Pack Color.
instruction.mlog.wait.tip: Wait a certain number of seconds.
instruction.mlog.write.tip:
Write a number to a linked memory cell.
Can also write to variables in other processors.
laccess.mlog.comparator.tip: Redstone strength a comparator reads from this block
laccess.mlog.emittedRedstone.tip: Redstone strength this block emits itself
laccess.mlog.emptySlots.tip: Number of slots still empty in the container
laccess.mlog.energyCapacity.tip: Maximum energy this block can store
laccess.mlog.firstItem.tip: First item in the container, null when empty
laccess.mlog.fluidLevel.tip: Amount of fluid at this position
laccess.mlog.hardness.tip: Time it takes to break this block
laccess.mlog.hasBlockEntity.tip: Whether this block has a block entity
laccess.mlog.hasFluid.tip: Whether there is fluid at this position
laccess.mlog.itemCapacity.tip: Maximum number of items this container holds
laccess.mlog.name: Name
laccess.mlog.open.tip: Whether a door or trapdoor is open
laccess.mlog.powered.tip: Whether this block is powered by redstone
laccess.mlog.progress.tip: Smelting progress of a furnace, 0 to 1
laccess.mlog.raining.tip: Whether it is raining at this position
laccess.mlog.redstone.tip: Strongest redstone signal from neighbouring blocks
laccess.mlog.solid.tip: Whether this block has a collision shape
laccess.mlog.totalItems.tip: Total number of items in the container
lcategory.mlog.io.description: Modify contents of memory blocks and processor buffers.
lglobal.@links: Number of blocks linked to this processor
